title: Paper Craft/Origami
content: Apply paper craft aesthetic suggesting folded, cut paper. Layered paper elements with shadows showing depth. Origami-inspired geometric shapes. Paper texture backgrounds. Fold lines and creases visible. Cut-out style illustrations. Soft shadows suggesting paper thickness. Muted, paper-like colors. Include paper corner folds and curls. Craft project, handmade atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create folded paper aesthetic with origami shapes, paper textures, and layered depth.
variants.detailed: Apply paper craft aesthetic suggesting folded, cut paper. Layered paper elements with shadows showing depth. Origami-inspired geometric shapes. Paper texture backgrounds. Fold lines and creases visible. Cut-out style illustrations. Soft shadows suggesting paper thickness. Muted, paper-like colors. Include paper corner folds and curls. Craft project, handmade atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply paper craft aesthetic with folded, layered paper feel. Paper layers: multiple elements stacked with increasing shadow-md to shadow-xl for depth, each layer slightly offset. Paper texture: subtle fiber pattern, aged paper color variations (cream, off-white, craft brown). Origami elements: geometric folded shapes (SVG with gradient faces suggesting 3D folds), angular forms. Fold lines: subtle diagonal creases across elements (thin line with gradient fade), corner folds (triangle in corner with shadow). Cut-out style: elements appear cut from paper - slightly rough edges (SVG filter or clip-path), layered over contrasting background. Shadows: soft, directional shadows suggesting paper floating above surface, consistent light direction. Corner curls: paper corners lifting (pseudo-element with curved gradient). Colors: paper palette - cream, kraft brown, white, subtle pastels like construction paper. Pop-up elements: 3D paper architecture style, elements appearing to fold out. Interactive: paper folding animations on hover, elements can flip or unfold. Torn edges: rough paper tear effect for dividers or edges. Tape and pins: decorative elements holding paper pieces. Collage: layered composition suggesting crafted arrangement. Implementation: CSS transforms for 3D paper folds, SVG for complex shapes. Performance: shadow-heavy design - optimize carefully. Accessibility: ensure paper colors provide sufficient text contrast, layer shadows dont obscure content.
